mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM lesson_document_content c INNER JOIN lesson_document_conversion j ON j.id = c.conversion_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND j.del_flag = '0' AND j.status = 2

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.source_file_name AS sourceFileName, c.source_type AS sourceType, c.block_count AS blockCount, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM lesson_document_content c INNER JOIN lesson_document_conversion j ON j.id = c.conversion_id WHERE j.del_flag = '0' AND j.status = 2 ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson_document_content c INNER JOIN lesson_document_conversion j ON j.id = c.conversion_id SET c.version = #{version}, c.title = #{title}, c.source_type = #{sourceType}, c.source_file_name = #{sourceFileName}, c.block_count = #{blockCount}, c.content_json = #{contentJson}, c.updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE c.id = #{id} AND j.del_flag = '0' AND j.status = 2
